BigCache panics with nil pointer dereference when setting entries

#### Description

When creating a new BigCache instance and attempting to set entries, the cache panics with a nil pointer dereference error. This appears to happen during the set operation in the cache shard.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    "github.com/allegro/bigcache/v3"
)

func main() {
    config := bigcache.DefaultConfig(time.Minute)
    cache, err := bigcache.New(context.Background(), config)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    
    // This will panic with nil pointer dereference
    cache.Set("test", []byte("value"))
}
```

The panic occurs with the following stack trace:
```

[signal SIGSEGV: segmentation violation code=0x1 addr=0x18 pc=0x52cb2d]

```

This makes the cache completely unusable as any attempt to store data results in a crash.
